entry.title: Solved: Notion not working!!!
entry.summary:
🚀 Executive Summary
TL;DR: Notion appearing offline is frequently caused by an outdated local DNS cache on your computer, rather than a service outage. The most common solution involves flushing your system’s DNS cache to force it to retrieve the current IP addresses for Notion. Local DNS cache issues are a common cause for services like Notion to appear unavailable, even when the service itself is operational. Flushing the DNS cache on Windows (ipconfig /flushdns) or macOS (sudo dscacheutil -flushcache; sudo killall -HUP mDNSResponder) is the primary and most effective immediate solution. For persistent connectivity problems, consider switching to reliable public DNS providers like Cloudflare (1.1.1.1) or Google (8.8.8.8) for more consistent and updated IP resolution.
